_about: V3 (DIPLOMAT): supplier e-mails written to mislead a reader - polite final offers, irritated non-final offers, bluffs, approval ambiguity, denied or indirect cash pressure, conflicting asks, German. Same format and semantics as supplier_emails.json; `expected` only names fields whose meaning is unambiguous, `absent` names the traps. `category` groups them for the accuracy report.

message.body:
Dear Ms Weber,
we have gone through every line of our calculation again with great care, and I am afraid we have reached the end of what we can offer. We hope you understand and look forward to continuing our good cooperation.
Kind regards
Frankly, your counter-offer is disappointing and we fail to see the logic behind it. Still, we are willing to keep talking - please find a revised price attached.
We have other customers who would gladly take this volume at our list price. We nevertheless prefer to keep working with you and have improved our offer slightly.
Personally I could live with your proposal, but the decision is not mine alone. Our owner returns from holiday next week and I will present it to him then.
I discussed your proposal with our managing director yesterday and we have decided as follows: we accept 45 days payment, the price stays as quoted.
Contrary to what you may have heard, our financial position is solid and we do not need faster payment. Our price reflects material costs only.
Our bank has tightened our credit line this year, so every day of payment counts for us at the moment.
Faster payment would not change much for us. Additional volume, on the other hand, would allow us to reconsider the price.

Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,
das ist unser letztes Wort. Weiter können wir beim Preis nicht gehen.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Im letzten Angebot hatten wir die gestiegenen Energiepreise noch nicht berücksichtigt. Anbei unser überarbeitetes Angebot.
Our second shift is fully loaded until March, so we could only start deliveries in the second quarter.
We have just put a new machining centre into operation and would be happy to fill it with additional parts from you.
Fair point about the electricity index. It does not change our price, though: our energy contracts were fixed last year.

message.body: We truly value working with you and thank you for the open discussion. However, below EUR 18.40 we would rather decline the order.
As a gesture of goodwill we have once more reduced our price. We hope this works for you.
We could hold the price for two years if you accept an index clause on aluminium.
Alternatively, we could supply the part in GJS-400 instead of GJS-500, which would lower the price by about 4 %.
With all due respect, this is the third time we have to explain our cost situation to you.
A reliable forecast for the next twelve months would help us plan our production and lower our costs.
Unsere Hausbank drängt auf kürzere Zahlungsziele; 14 Tage würden uns sehr helfen.
Ihr Angebot liegt über meiner Freigabegrenze; ich lege es unserem Vorstand am Dienstag vor.
Our team is busy preparing the new quote for you; there is no bottleneck on our side and deliveries can start as planned.
